overview.name: Allspring Core Plus ETF
overview.description: Under normal circumstances, the manager invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets in debt securities; up to 35% of the fund's total assets in debt securities that are below investment-grade; and up to 25% of the fund's total assets in debt securities of foreign issuers, including emerging markets issuers and debt securities denominated in foreign currencies.
